verdict.rationale: Jitsu's Profile Builder creates customer profile records from `traits` in identify events and writes them to your warehouse as a documented store. Custom JavaScript logic can draw on up to a year of user event history, and identity stitching links anonymous records to known users, so a data engineer can query unified profiles there. Missing for 10: a dedicated profile lookup/query API (access is only via the warehouse), documented profile table schema covering identifiers and event history, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Profile Builder.
